description:
Search notes and logs, and summarise thread activity. Returns pointers only: absolute paths plus metadata, never file bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--text TEXT] [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — find notes
  logs [--thread T] [--text TEXT] [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — find daily logs
  activity [--thread T] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — rank threads by activity in a window
  overview THREAD [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — full picture of one thread
  stream [--thread T] [--kind KINDS] [--text TEXT] [--today] [--reverse] [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — every dated record merged into one chronology

Flags:
  all: --thread / THREAD takes a name, 'Kind/Name' or a wikilink. --since and --until take YYYY-MM-DD and are inclusive. --json gives JSON output.
  notes: --type is a note type such as Meeting (case-insensitive). --text is a case-insensitive literal matched against topic and body. --limit default 20; 0 means all.
  logs: --text is matched against entry lines. --limit default 20; 0 means all.
  overview: --limit sets how many recent items are listed. Default 5; 0 means all.
  stream: --kind is a comma-separated list from: note, log, task, done, hours, payment, thread, person, pending. Default: all. --text is matched against thread and summary. --today is shorthand for today only. --reverse lists oldest first (default newest first). --limit default 100; 0 means all.

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--type", "Meeting", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--json"]
  ["logs", "--text", "invoice", "--limit", "0"]
  ["overview", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["stream", "--today", "--kind", "note,log,hours"]

Notes:
  Dates are event dates (frontmatter timestamp), not the date a file was written.
  --text does not search hours descriptions.
  Read a result with notes cat STEM or by opening the returned absolute path.
  Files that are not valid UTF-8 are skipped; lint reports them.
  Exit 1: unknown --kind value.
